subject.title: fix(kill-tree): verify process group leader before using group kill to prevent gateway SIGTERM (#76259)

question: Should OpenClaw accept leader-verified group kill plus direct-pid fallback as the default Unix behavior for callers that omit `detached`?
rationale: This is a real bug fix, but it deliberately changes shared process cleanup semantics for existing omitted callers and can trade gateway self-termination risk for descendant-leak risk when process-group leadership cannot be verified.

options.title: Accept guarded default
options.body: Land the guarded helper behavior after refresh/CI if maintainers prefer direct-pid fallback over risking gateway process-group termination for unverifiable omitted callers.

options.title: Require explicit caller state only
options.body: Ask for a different patch that keeps default behavior stable and requires every process-tree caller to pass the effective spawn detachment state.

options.title: Pause for owner rewrite
options.body: Hold this PR if process cleanup ownership needs a broader refactor before changing the shared helper contract.

recommendation.title: Accept guarded default
recommendation.body: Land the guarded helper behavior after refresh/CI if maintainers prefer direct-pid fallback over risking gateway process-group termination for unverifiable omitted callers.

likelyOwner.reason: This account approved and merged the prior detached-option fix whose compatibility boundary this PR revises.
